notes: Clauses scanned in privacy policies and terms. `pattern` is matched against the policy text; `negation` (if present) matched in the same sentence flips the finding into a positive signal (`positiveLabel`) or suppresses it. Severity 0 rows are informational. Keep patterns conservative; policies are long and repetitive.

rules.name: Sells personal information
rules.label: Sells your data
rules.why: The policy says personal information may be sold.
rules.pattern: \b(we|the company|our company|us)\b(?: [a-z]+){0,3}? (sell|sells|sold|rent|rents)\b[^.]{0,100}\b(personal (information|data)|your (information|data)|user data|information about you)\b|\b(personal (information|data)|your (information|data))\b[^.]{0,60}\b(may be|is|are|will be|was|were) (sold|rented)\b
rules.negation: \b(do not|don'?t|never|will not|won'?t|not|have not|did not|no longer)\b[^.]{0,50}\b(sell|sold|share|rent|disclose|collect|use|engage)\b|\bno sale of\b|\b(sale of (all|substantially|some|our|its|the|a) |merger|acquisition|bankruptcy|insolvency|receivership|we mean|is defined|definition|right to|residents? (have|has)|purpose of|categories of|request)\b

rules.name: 'Share or sell' (CCPA definition)
rules.label: Shares data for ads
rules.why: Admits 'sharing' data for cross-context advertising (a sale under California law).
rules.negation: \b(do not|don'?t|never|will not|won'?t|not|have not|did not|no longer)\b[^.]{0,50}\b(sell|sold|share|rent|disclose|collect|use|engage)\b|\b(we mean|is defined|definition|right to|request|purpose of)\b|\bcategories of (third parties|sources)\b[^.]{0,20}\b(with|from) (whom|which)\b

rules.name: Shares data with third parties for their marketing
rules.label: Shared with partners
rules.why: Your data goes to third parties for their own marketing.
rules.negation: \b(do not|don'?t|never|will not|won'?t|not|have not|did not|no longer)\b[^.]{0,50}\b(sell|sold|share|rent|disclose|collect|use|engage)\b|\bask for your consent\b

rules.name: Data brokers or data enrichment
rules.label: Data brokers
rules.why: Adds data bought from brokers to what it knows.

rules.name: Combines data from other sources
rules.label: Profile building
rules.why: Combines what you do here with data bought elsewhere.

rules.name: Precise geolocation
rules.label: Precise location
rules.why: Collects GPS-level location.

rules.name: Biometric or sensitive data
rules.label: Sensitive data
rules.why: Collects biometric, health, or similarly sensitive data.
rules.negation: \b(do not|don'?t|never|will not|won'?t|not|have not|did not|no longer)\b[^.]{0,50}\b(sell|sold|share|rent|disclose|collect|use|engage)\b|\bprotected health information\b|\bhipaa\b|\bnotice of privacy practices\b|\bcomply with\b

rules.name: Cross-device tracking
rules.label: Cross-device tracking
rules.why: Links your phone, laptop and TV into one profile.

rules.name: Vague or indefinite retention
rules.label: Keeps data indefinitely
rules.why: No concrete limit on how long data is kept.

rules.name: Forced arbitration / class-action waiver
rules.label: No right to sue
rules.why: You waive courts and class actions by using the site.
rules.pattern: \b(binding arbitration|mandatory arbitration|arbitration agreement|class[- ]action waiver|waive (your|the) right to (a )?(jury|class|trial)|individual basis only)\b
rules.negation: data privacy framework|privacy shield|\bdpf\b|arbitration option|at your request

rules.name: Terms can change on their say-so
rules.label: Can change terms
rules.why: They may change these terms on their own at any time.
rules.pattern: (\b(may|reserves? the right to|can|is entitled to|has the right to)\b[^.]{0,40}\b(change|modify|update|amend|revise|alter|vary|replace)\b[^.]{0,120}\b(at any time|without (prior )?notice|at (our|its) (sole |absolute )?discretion|from time to time|periodically)|continued use[^.]{0,60}(constitutes|means|signifies|is deemed)[^.]{0,30}(acceptance|consent|agreement))

rules.name: Collects data from children
rules.label: Children's data
rules.why: Knowingly collects data from users under 13/16.

rules.name: Inferences and profiling
rules.label: Profiles you

rules.name: Offers data deletion
rules.label: Deletion offered
rules.why: You can request deletion of your data.

rules.name: Relies on 'legitimate interest' for ads
rules.label: 'Legitimate interest'

rules.name: Subscription renews automatically
rules.label: Auto-renews
rules.why: The terms say the subscription renews unless you cancel first.

rules.label: Non-refundable
rules.why: Refunds only where the terms expressly allow them.
